raw_prompt: !fix so the vengeful creeper script. two main flaws. one, the creepers break blocks so it's annoying. two, the creeper explosion technically triggers the damage script, so it spawns another one. creeper damage shouldn't even trigger it in general
reviewer_feedback: Updated the Vengeful Creeper script to prevent block damage and stop infinite spawn loops caused by creeper explosions.
usage_instructions: Vengeful creepers now deal damage without destroying blocks.
Creeper explosions no longer trigger the spawn of new creepers.

mutations.content:
on damage:
    victim is a player
    attacker is set
    attacker is not a player
    attacker is not a creeper
    spawn a creeper at location of victim
    set {_creeper} to last spawned creeper
    set target of {_creeper} to attacker
    set {vengeful::%uuid of {_creeper}%} to true

on target:
    event-entity is a creeper
    {vengeful::%uuid of event-entity%} is true
    target is a player
    cancel event

on damage of a player:
    attacker is a creeper
    {vengeful::%uuid of attacker%} is true
    cancel event

on explode:
    event-entity is a creeper
    {vengeful::%uuid of event-entity%} is true
    cancel event
    create a safe explosion of force 3 at location of event-entity
    delete {vengeful::%uuid of event-entity%}

every 1 second:
    loop all entities:
        loop-entity is a creeper
        {vengeful::%uuid of loop-entity%} is true
        if target of loop-entity is not set:
            kill loop-entity
            delete {vengeful::%uuid of loop-entity%}
        else if loop-entity is in the ignition process:
            create a safe explosion of force 3 at location of loop-entity
            kill loop-entity
            delete {vengeful::%uuid of loop-entity%}

on death of a creeper:
    if {vengeful::%uuid of victim%} is true:
        delete {vengeful::%uuid of victim%}

traces.intent_summary: Modify the vengeful creeper script to prevent block damage during explosions and exclude creeper-caused damage from triggering the spawning logic.

traces.rationale:
Addressed both flaws in mobs/vengeful_creeper.sk:
1. Prevent block destruction: Updated the loop explosion to 'create a safe explosion of force 3', which deals damage without breaking blocks. Additionally added an 'on explode:' handler targeting vengeful creepers to cancel natural destructive explosions and substitute a safe explosion.
2. Prevent feedback loop / creeper damage triggering the spawn: Added 'attacker is not a creeper' to the 'on damage:' listener so that explosions or damage from creepers will never trigger the retaliatory spawn.
